The PLANTED CASE (UCS-1158): `relates.see-also` above carries a SYNTHESIZED
CALL NUMBER where an accession belongs. A call number is a display string
generated for one browse-tree projection; the citation grammar is accession-only
(UCS-1147), so this must be a finding rather than a resolvable reference.

If it ever resolved, the accession inversion would reverse itself one convenient
citation at a time — a reference pointing at a POSITION again, breaking the
moment the leaf is reclassified.
